name: Boobie Ike
summary: The flamboyant Vice City mogul who built a legit-looking business empire on drug money and constantly hunts for his next mainstream hit.
description: Boobie Ike represents the modern transformation of Vice City's cash-heavy illicit economy into commercial real estate, luxury nightlife lounges, and entertainment ventures. Flanked by high-end jewelry and an entourage of influencers, Boobie offers high-paying contracts to operators capable of keeping problems away from his legitimate front corporations.

seo.title: Boobie Ike: Vice City Mogul & Empire Boss
seo.description: Comprehensive guide to Boobie Ike in GTA VI. Learn about his entertainment empire, nightclub assets, and missions with Lucia and Jason.
